seoTitle: Baltimore City Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Dates, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: See the Baltimore City Schools 2025-2026 calendar with first day, holidays, early release days, breaks, recovery days, official PDF and ICS download.
heroSummary: Baltimore City Public Schools begins the 2025-2026 school year for most traditional schools on Monday, August 25, 2025. Spring break runs March 28-April 6, 2026. The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 11, unless inclement weather recovery days are needed.
heroSummaryFacts: Early release is four hours after start time
calendarNotes: Baltimore City Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 25, 2025 for traditional schools, while noting that some charter schools may use a different start date. The calendar includes multiple professional development days when schools are closed for students. Early release days mean schools release four hours after the start time. Winter break runs December 24, 2025 through January 4, 2026, with schools returning Monday, January 5. Spring break runs March 28-April 6, 2026. The scheduled last day is June 11, 2026, unless inclement weather recovery days are needed on June 12, June 15, or June 16.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Baltimore City Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Baltimore City Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year for most traditional schools on Monday, August 25, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Baltimore City Schools Spring Break in 2026?
When is the last scheduled day for Baltimore City Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day is Thursday, June 11, 2026, unless inclement weather recovery days are needed.

calendarFaqs.q: What are the Baltimore City Schools inclement weather recovery days in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists June 12, June 15, and June 16, 2026 as inclement weather recovery days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Baltimore City dates are easy to miss in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Dates families often miss include early release days on October 16, October 31, January 16, March 27, and June 11, plus student-only professional development closures on October 17, November 7, January 9, February 6, March 6, and May 1.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2025-2026 Baltimore City calendar apply to charter schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar says it applies to most schools and notes that some charter schools may have a different start date. Families should confirm school-specific dates with their school leader.
